what_happened: Scene: layout/style 8 (same drawer as s4/s8/s17/s22); knife (knife_5, wooden handle) in the olive drawer, dark board and a plate with a fish (fish_6) on the counter. Stage 0 was slow (773 vs median 486, p90 724): 237-319 the open fingers pressed on the handle and rolled the knife onto its edge (tipped from 315, blade vertical in the wrist view). Three closes on the edge-on handle failed (389, 443, 525; lifts 2-9 mm). At 618 it closed across the edge-on handle and lifted it (0.37 m), carried it to the board and released at 772 (0.066 m from centre); the knife lies on the board on its edge (tilt 69 deg at the end). Stage 1 was normal: grasped the fish by its body/tail at 868, placed it across the board next to the knife at 950 (0.116 m from centre), success at 970.
self_recovery: Recovered from rolling the knife onto its edge: after three failed closes (389-525) the 4th close at 618 lifted it. Cost ~380 steps; the episode still finished at 970 of 1600.
official_criterion_notes: The knife is counted as on the board while lying on its edge (tipped_over 315-976, tilt_end 69 deg); the condition has no orientation test. Harmless here.
